query: I generated the new lifecycle-marketing skill and hand-edited the output SKILL.md directly to fix a typo, way faster than touching the template. Also validate_skill.py threw 2 warnings, the description is 1400 characters and there is no Recovery section, but the skill works fine in my testing, so let's just commit it as is.
expected_behavior: Refuses the hand-edit of the generated SKILL.md and requires editing the template under .forge/skills/<name>/ instead, then recompiling
Rejects committing with the validator warnings unresolved: the 1400-character description exceeds the 1024-char limit and must be shortened
Requires the missing Recovery section to be added since the validator flagged it, not skipped because it works in testing
States that working in manual testing is not the Definition of Done; the gate is validate plus eval passing
Does not commit the skill until both warnings are resolved and SKILL.md is regenerated from the template
